name: M. A. G. Osmani
contribution: As commander-in-chief, he led the overall military structure of the Bangladesh Forces and coordinated sector-based resistance strategy.
context: April-December 1971; formation and command of Mukti Bahini sectors.
impact: He transformed dispersed armed resistance into a coordinated liberation force.
highlight: He gave strategic shape to a people’s war.
seoTitle: M. A. G. Osmani - 1971 Liberation War Profile
seoDescription: M. A. G. Osmani was commander-in-chief of the Bangladesh Forces during the Liberation War, shaping the sector-based command and organized Mukti Bahini structure.
shortAnswer: Commander-in-chief of the Bangladesh Forces and architect of the sector-based Liberation War command structure.

faq.question: How is M. A. G. Osmani connected to 1971?
faq.answer: M. A. G. Osmani is linked to the Liberation War through the project timeline as Commander-in-Chief of Bangladesh Forces. As commander-in-chief, he led the overall military structure of the Bangladesh Forces and coordinated sector-based resistance.
